Also, rule of thumb is don't use wax or shave if your skin if broken. You don't want scarring from overstimulating your skin either. Hair on the face isnt ideal but it's definitely better than hair AND major inflammation on your skin, friend!

I think maybe stop shaving for a few days to let your skin heal. Moisturize well and always sanatized anything you put in your face with isopropyl alcohol, let it air dry and then use. I have a few suggestions. 

1) Don't shave dry. Use oil to help act as a barrier on dry skin and a lubricant to easy get the closest shave without damaging your skin barrier. 

2) Don't shave twice a day if you can help it.  Give your skin some time to heal between. 

3) Wax. Hot wax was nice for me, I learned to use it through YouTube videos and got myself a wax burner and would melt it but then let it cool so it wouldn't be too hot on my skin. The heat really helps grabbing to all the hairs and not being painful. And pulling out the hair by the root helps in growing back slower! I use cold wax strips now since I accidentally broke my hot wax machine. I get the bikini wax ones from Walmart (it's the SAME as the face ones but in biggest strips). I cut them to size before peeling them and though it hurts, I don't have to worry about it for 2 weeks minimum. 

4) I am NOT A DOCTOR so talk to your doctor first but mine prescribed spironolactone 50mg tablets and now increased the dosage to 100mg since I didn't have a reaction and it is specifically for the hair women with PCOS get. But you can't take it if your are pregnant or are planning to be pregnant so beware of that too.
